chapter: Rhythm Club memories and playing technique
title: Bubber Miley

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: When you looked at the discography, did any of those other names jog some memories beside Ward and

Yes, Bubba Miley. Now I didn't know Bubba. See Bubba was just a little before my time. He passed on quite early, I guess it was early '30s, I don't recall, but I remember him, I used to read about him, Bubba Miley with Duke Ellington. He died early in the early '30s if I'm not mistaken.
'32 and I wasn't acquainted with his work too much. I liked it, what he did; I liked him with Duke Ellington. And the different various recordings that he was on.
I'm sure you knew his successor, Cootie Williams.
